caption.title: One record across departments and institutions
caption.sub: Results from internal departments, referring hospitals and external laboratories, consolidated per patient.

caption.title: Completeness stated in the patient banner
caption.sub: Results not received, not stored electronically or pending verification, before the record is acted on.

caption.title: Provenance and receipt status per document
caption.sub: Structured, converted, unverified or not stored, with the sending organisation.

caption.title: Referral
caption.sub: Recipient and channel are resolved from the institution register. A clinical question is mandatory.

steps.type: Back-referral after chest pain work-up. Please continue follow-up.

caption.title: Content as received by the recipient
caption.sub: Verified results are transmitted as structured data; unverified results as images, labelled unverified.

caption.title: Referral sent through Twiin
caption.sub: Transmission and acknowledgement are recorded per patient.

caption.title: Audit trail
caption.sub: Every referral, result request and receipt, with sender, recipient, format and acknowledgement.

caption.title: Results received outside the interfaces
caption.sub: Fax, scanned documents, secure mail and chat. The sender is identified through the institution register, not the fax header.

caption.title: Filed after review
caption.sub: Patient and value are confirmed before filing; the result is recorded as unverified.

caption.title: Report without a patient match
caption.sub: No BSN, and no match on name and date of birth. Held for manual matching; the source message is retained.

caption.title: Matched to the patient
caption.sub: The report is linked to the record and the match is logged.

caption.title: Management overview
caption.sub: Results per source and per department, by receipt status. Senders still reporting by fax are identified per source.

caption.title: Code and unit conversion
caption.sub: Mappings per sender to LOINC and UCUM, reviewed and versioned. Original values retained.

caption.title: Departmental databases
caption.sub: Existing local registries are read without migration. Nothing is written back.

caption.title: Connections
caption.sub: HL7 v2, EDIFACT, Twiin, ZorgMail, fax and scanning folders, monitored per channel.

caption.title: Institution register
caption.sub: AGB and URA codes, preferred channel and verification status per institution.

caption.title: Access log
caption.sub: Access to patient data with user, action and legal basis. Exportable per patient.

caption.title: Unit conversion on receipt
caption.sub: Reported value, conversion and LOINC code are shown with the result.

caption.title: Values obtained by text recognition
caption.sub: Unverified until confirmed by a clinician against the source image.

caption.title: Verified
caption.sub: User and time are recorded with the result.

caption.title: Result not stored electronically
caption.sub: Point-of-care troponin, reported by the referring hospital by fax only.

caption.title: Result request
caption.sub: Through ZorgMail, Twiin or the regional platform. An upload link only where no network connection exists.

caption.title: Regional platform query
caption.sub: Results published to the regional exchange are retrieved by BSN.

caption.title: Imported as a structured result
caption.sub: Source and time of receipt are recorded.

caption.title: Ready for regional exchange
caption.sub: As regional platforms take over transport between institutions, results still reach departments by fax, mail, scan and local databases. Those remain covered.
